# Municipal Ordinance No. 12, Series of 2024

**Term Loan Agreement and Assignment of Deposit with Hold-out Control Agreement**

## Summary

This ordinance approves and ratifies the term loan agreement and assignment of deposit with hold-out control agreement, both dated October 7, [[2024]], between the Municipal Government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] and the [[Development Bank of the Philippines]] (DBP). The agreement involves a loan for the acquisition of heavy equipment and infrastructure projects. The ordinance authorizes the Municipal Mayor to execute necessary documents and ensures compliance with legal requirements.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Authorization:** The Municipal Mayor is authorized to enter into a Term Loan Agreement and Assignment of Deposit with Hold-out and Control Agreement with the [[Development Bank of the Philippines]] (DBP) for P84,000,000.00, in accordance with [[Sec-297-RA7160|Section 297]] of [[RA-7160]].
2.  **Purpose:** The loan is intended for funding priority projects, specifically the acquisition of heavy equipment.
3.  **Equipment:** The heavy equipment to be acquired includes: a) 1-unit Backhoe Loader, b) 1-unit Hydraulic Excavator, c) 1-unit Motor Grader, d) 1-unit Vibratory Compactor, e) 1-unit Dump Truck, and f) 1-unit 6x4 Self Loader Truck.
4.  **Terms:** The terms of the loan agreement and assignment of deposit with hold-out and control agreement are approved and ratified.
5.  **Appropriation:** The Municipality appropriates the entire proceeds of the borrowing exclusively to finance the acquisition of the heavy equipment.
6.  **Authority to Disclose:** The Municipality grants its Municipal Mayor authority to execute a letter waiving rights to confidentiality of information by DBP, the [[Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas]] (BSP), and all financial institutions.
7.  **Ratification:** The [[Sangguniang Bayan]] approves and ratifies all the terms and conditions of the Term Loan Agreement and Assignment of Deposit with Hold-out & Control Agreement both dated October 7, [[2024]].
8.  **Effectivity:** The Ordinance shall take effect upon compliance with all procedures required under [[RA-7160]].

- [[RA-7160|Republic Act No. 7160]] (Local Government Code of 1991)
  - [[Sec-297-RA7160|Section 297]] — Loans, Credits, and Other Forms of Indebtedness of Local Government Units

## Timeline

- October 7, [[2024]]: Date of the Term Loan Agreement and Assignment of Deposit with Hold-out Control Agreement.
- October 14, [[2024]]: Date of the Regular Session of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] where the ordinance was enacted.
- October 29, [[2024]]: Date of approval by the Municipal Mayor.
